descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S08 Existing specs: Generate opens Post-Round with the note, which survives a reload; a failed generation shows a clear error and keeps the dictation (both modes)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U10 Generate AI Note moves the physician to Post-Round with the generated note there. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • T8 If both models fail, a clear error shows and the dictation is not lost (Empty & Failure States: 'Note not generated' shown, dictation kept; … (TFA-94422 AC 5; UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT OAT-03)
  • U4 Generation runs on the server: the physician can tap Generate and move to another patient; the Post-Round tab shows a 'generating' state, and on return the note is there or an explicit failure shows, … (UAT TC-14; UAT 3.5; TFA-92592 AC 15) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Tim's chromium specs: one with a mocked note (Hospital), two calling the configured model (Hospital and Nursing Home, each with a failure then a retry), and one where the first ai/notes:generateNote request fails at the socket (Hospital)

When Run the four specs by title

Then After Generate Note & Finish the 'AI-Generated Note' view is open with the generated text, the note and status are saved, and after a reload Post-Round still shows it, in both modes. When generation fails, an explicit message says the dictation is saved and the note could not be generated; the dictation stays in the box and in the database; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright verdicts. These run while the chart stays open; leaving the chart is S07 and S26. The failure half covers T8's 'clear error, dictation kept' with the build's wording ('…the formatted note couldn’t be generated and saved…'), not the UAT's 'Note not generated', so T8's wording half is reported with Q18, not as a silent accept (merged from S09)

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S08 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92592 ready for pr; TFA-94422 ready for qa

Nothing is wrong for the physician here. Tim's old Playwright specs still click Generate and then wait for tasks, but since 10-12 a single Stop generates the note automatically, and the SNF fixture has no pre-round text, so both specs time out.

Evidence: Allure 0f438342, verdict test out of date (local). encounter-workflow.spec.ts:156: 7f3907f auto-generates on Stop (EncounterTab.tsx:84) and 726f724 stops deriving tasks after Generate. note-generation.spec.ts:248: the fixture has no rawPreRoundNotes, so 3878afa's stale guard keeps Generate disabled (red since 09-24). Bisected on an isolated stack: 5d83248 is not a regression.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

Result: failed in matrix/TC-14.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Test out of date (local) — the test is out of date, the product is right; not a product failure.

  • encounter-workflow.spec.ts:156: The same "one Stop generates the note" change (7f3907f, EncounterTab.tsx:84), plus Vikram's 726f724 (09-24), which stopped deriving tasks after Generate; the test still follows the old flow (click Generate, wait for tasks).
  • note-generation.spec.ts:248: The fixture has no rawPreRoundNotes, so the stale check from Vikram's 3878afa (09-24) keeps Generate disabled; red since 09-24.

Bisected on an isolated stack over 7f3907f^, 5d83248^ and 5d83248: 5d83248 brought no regression.

Existing specs:

  • encounter-workflow.spec.ts [chromium] — a generation failure keeps the saved dictation in the encounter — expected
  • encounter-workflow.spec.ts [chromium] — Generate Note transitions with the dictated source attached — unexpected
  • note-generation.spec.ts [chromium] — hospital encounter retries, persists, edits, reloads, and finalizes the real note — expected
  • note-generation.spec.ts [chromium] — SNF encounter retries, persists, reloads, and edits the real note — unexpected

Failure screenshots and page snapshots are on the failing steps. Videos stay in matrix/TC-14-artifacts/ (not attached).

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's chromium specs): fresh @roundai.test accounts made with the local admin key, a mocked note and a generateNote failure injected at the Convex socket; dev has no admin key, no action mock and one shared account, so they run on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
